run_gemm_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing cuBLAS and cuTlass GEMM performance on CUDA with configurable matrix sizes
measure_blas_performance: measure cuBLAS matrix multiplication performance by timing torch.mm calls over multiple steps on GPU
measure_tlass_performance: measure cuTlass matrix multiplication performance by timing torch.ops.fb.mm calls over multiple steps on GPU
run_single_gemm_test: run a single GEMM test with given M, N, K dimensions using either cuBLAS or cuTlass backend
review_run_benchmark_dataset: review the run function that benchmarks a dataset of M, N, K matrix size tuples against both backends
